name: Textured sphere
summary: A marbled sphere that swells and distorts with the bass, its surface boiling slowly, spikes rising with the highs, over its own reflection if you like.
credit: After vizz.fm's Textured Sphere (https://vizz.fm). No code used; written new with Claude Code.
hint: The bass swells the sphere and stirs its surface; each beat gives it a kick; the highs raise spikes. The texture turns with the sphere and flows with the music: marble, bands like a gas giant's, or contour lines. Colours come from the palette.

params.label: Distortion
params.help: How far the surface bulges and dents.

params.label: Lumps
params.help: Few big lumps or many small ones.

params.label: Spikes
params.help: Sharp ridges that rise with the highs.

params.label: Texture
params.help: Marble: swirled veins. Bands: stripes stirred like a gas giant's. Lines: contour lines of the marble, glowing.

params.label: Flow
params.help: How fast the texture swirls, faster with the mids.

params.label: Bass swell
params.help: How much the bass makes the sphere bigger.

params.label: Bass stir
params.help: How much the bass deepens the distortion.

params.label: Light
params.help: How much a light from above left shapes it; at 0 it glows evenly.

params.label: Reflection
params.help: The sphere hovering over a dark floor that mirrors it.
